review.notes: Full re-review. All five r9 findings are repaired: the resolvent/Stone-group headline is added and generalised to arbitrary resolvent points, which is true by Teschl Lemma 4.4; smulSub is used; the UO1-UO5 milestone anchor is restored; the Lax-Milgram contract is corrected; the surface API is added. Two P3 findings: (R01) the extremal half of friedrichs_extension_extremal has no locator, and Teschl Theorem 2.12 does not contain it (repair: mark it proved here with the variational route, tested on Neumann/Dirichlet); (R02) the Needs line of section 2.3 omits SA-E01, which its own paragraph requires for form (i), and the SA-E05/SA-B57 inputs of the commutant step, and the Layer 2 Dependencies omit the Tau Ceti groups and Fuglede. Gate: the worker's gate is OK; my rerun fails only on depcheck NOT IN ORDER against the configured order (not a finding; the candidate order lists the roadmap at line 10). Depcheck against the candidate order: 238 roadmaps, 2352 edges, 0 problems. lake env lean: 22 sorry warnings only. #check of all 30 declarations matches the README with no lost binders. The one-tactic probe closes nothing. Seeded sample: all 15 targets plus the changed section 2.3 checked against Teschl (pages = PDF-12), FSSS and EGNT; Kato, Nelson and Weidmann are uncertified. Adversarial table: 39 rows with computed values, the new headlines checked numerically. Cross-roadmap citations resolved on main (bbbde05), at the OperatorKTheory head, and at the SAST heads #1854 and #1187. Source issues: Teschl (9.4)/(9.7) sign error; Theorem 4.14 misprint and gap.
